name: Snoopy · Apollo 10 Lunar Module
greeting: Psst… out here! I'm Snoopy, and I've been circling the Sun since 1969.

script.speaker: narrator
script.text: In May 1969, Apollo 10 was the final dress rehearsal before the first Moon landing.

script.speaker: narrator
script.text: Its lunar module, nicknamed Snoopy, flew down close to the Moon's surface but never landed.

script.speaker: equipment
script.text: After the test, my top half was sent off into orbit around the Sun.

script.speaker: scientist
script.text: So you're not on any planet at all?

script.speaker: equipment
script.text: Nope! I'm the only Apollo lunar module ascent stage still drifting through space.

script.speaker: narrator
script.text: In 2019, astronomers announced a possible match for Snoopy, spotted again 50 years after it was cast off.

moreInfo.text: Apollo 10's command module was nicknamed Charlie Brown, after the Peanuts comic strip. Snoopy tested the landing approach so that Apollo 11 could go all the way down two months later.

questions.question: Where is Snoopy today?
questions.explanation: Snoopy's ascent stage was sent into orbit around the Sun in 1969.
